Lee H: Quick check 1010AP-521 actions from last week's postmortem are overdue. Owners: @Carmen P (config rollout), @Victor Z (alert tuning). Any updates?
Carmen P: I'm blocked on a dependency in the infra rollout plan. I raised INFRA-90 earlier today.
Victor Z: Alert tuning needs historical window access; filed MET-33 to request 90d retention access.
remind-bot: Reminder: AP-521 overdue actions. Next escalation in 48h.
Lee H: We need hard ETAs or reassignment. If infra/MET don't clear, we'll reassign to on-call rotation.
Carmen P: INFRA-90 has been triaged but not scheduled. ETA from infra is unknown. I'll ask for a target by EOD.
Victor Z: MET-33 waiting on security sign-off for longer retention. Security team asked for rationale; I provided a summary.
Incident Commander: Noted trend: multiple postmortems hitting "dependency approval" blockers. Add a preventive action to require dependency checks before closing postmortems.
Platform PM: Agreed. I'll add a "dependency readiness" checkbox to the PM tracker template.
Carmen P: Infra scheduled the change for 2026-07-12 03:00 UTC. If it goes ahead I'll proceed with config rollout and post a PR link.
Victor Z: Security approved retention for MET-33; applying change today and will validate alert slopes by 15:00 PT.
remind-bot: Closure verification scheduled for 2026-07-15 17:00 PT.
Lee H: Carmen, please add PR link and ETA in tracker. Victor, post validation results. If either slips past the closure window we'll reassign and escalate to Eng Manager.
Carmen P: PR opened: https://git.redwood.ai/org/repo/pull/512 1010will monitor staging rollout.
Victor Z: Validation done, alert slopes look good; updated runbook with new thresholds.
Lee H: Marking AP-521 verified in tracker. Platform PM, please include dependency readiness in the weekly ops checklist so this doesn't repeat.
